brand.text:
BRAND NOTES
Name: MaeDay (brand), Mae (the voice on the phone). Tagline: When it's a mayday, Mae answers.
Look: Midnight + Porch Amber. Night, a lit window, calm. Deliberately unlike the cobalt receptionist site (no pills, no Space Grotesk, no Inter).
Fonts: Bricolage Grotesque, Instrument Sans, IBM Plex Mono (Google Fonts).
Trademark screen 14 Nov 2026: no MAEDAY / MAE DAY / CALL MAE marks at USPTO. Attorney check before filing (class 35, 42).

build.text:
BUILD NOTES
Next.js App Router, static export, Tailwind v4 (copy Nipstar/ai-receptionist pattern). Host: Cloudflare Pages or Vercel [confirm].
src/site.config.ts holds plans, prices, overage, setup fee, competitor table + check dates.
NEXT_PUBLIC_* env: demo line, booking URL, order form URL, contact details.
Voice: Retell + Twilio. Booking: [GHL calendar or Cal.com, confirm]. Starter order form: [GHL or Stripe, confirm].
scripts/check.ts: copy rules (no em dashes, no exclamation marks, banned words, no unbracketed TBCs at launch).
llms.txt, JSON-LD from the same data as visible FAQs, vercel.json / public/_headers.
Cross-link: footer + pricing FAQ to aireceptionistforsmallbusiness.net/for/property-management/ and back.
